property_summary: For any caller address a that currently has zero tokenBalance, calling airDrop from a will always increase tokenBalance(a) by 20 (reference); the mutant that requires tokenBalance>0 prevents zero-balance callers from receiving the airdrop, breaking this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Changed hasNoBalance to require the caller already has a positive balance, allowing only existing holders to receive the airdrop and changing tokenBalance outcomes for some keys.
